kim.p: Quick heads-up  SummitRetail agreed to a short case study. 20m interview + signed quote follow-up. Need Qs, legal release, design, and lead routing.
oliver.m: great. timezone: CET for their ML lead. propose Wed 09:00 CET.
kim.p: Wed 2026-09-09 09:00 CET works. can someone draft compact Qs (7) + 2 pull-quote prompts?
oliver.m: sending draft in thread: 1) role + product use 2) model/workload + job id 3) baseline vs current latency 4) config touched (batching/cache) 5) business outcomes 6) short quote to verify metric + signoff 7) any embargo/legal constraints. pull-quotes: one-sentence impact + metric with name.
nora_legal: reminder: for numeric claims we need either run artifacts (config/logs/job id) or a signed attestation. 72h turnaround on quote release. no PII in screenshots.
design_team: once quote signed send logo SVG + headshot. we'll produce hero + 2 socials (48h after signoff).
ops-bot: calendar created: Wed 2026-09-09 09:00 CET  invite pending. recording off by default.
sam.ae: routing note: incoming leads from the case page -> AE EMEA queue (ae-emea) and tag priority:enterprise; set lead score 87.
kim.p: setting embargo to publish day 00:00 UTC. will post final invite + Qs after SummitRetail confirms. :sparkles:
